title: TRICARE Premium-Based Plans Purchase Windows, Effective Dates and Initial Payment
content:
A **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans** purchase is made either during open season or within a qualifying-life-event window recorded in DEERS. The tier fixes the window, the date the purchase takes effect and how many monthly premiums must accompany the purchase.

| Tier | Qualifying-life-event window (calendar days after the DEERS event) | Open-season purchase | Effective date, qualifying-life-event purchase | Effective date, open-season purchase | Monthly premiums accompanying the purchase |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only | 90 | allowed | the date of the qualifying life event | 1 January of the following plan year | 2 |
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family | 90 | allowed | the date of the qualifying life event | 1 January of the following plan year | 2 |
| TRICARE Young Adult Select | 90 | allowed | the date of the qualifying life event | 1 January of the following plan year | 2 |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only | 90 | allowed | the date of the qualifying life event | 1 January of the following plan year | 2 |
| TRICARE Young Adult Prime | 90 | allowed | the date of the qualifying life event | 1 January of the following plan year | 2 |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family | 90 | allowed | the date of the qualifying life event | 1 January of the following plan year | 2 |

All six tiers share the same figures; each tier applies its own row.

## Illustrations (hypothetical dates)

- A purchase relying on a DEERS-recorded marriage of 12 May takes effect on 12 May.
- A purchase made during the open season of a plan year takes effect on 1 January of the following plan year.
- In either case the purchase is accompanied by 2 monthly premiums.
